column1: # The Java and Kotlin libraries Gradle packs into the APK (debugRuntimeClasspath of
# `gradlew :app:androidDependencies`), with their licence as their POM declares it
# and the one this project takes. Kept by hand: build-android.ps1 stops when Gradle
# and this list differ (scripts/apk-census.py deps), and the release checks the APK
# itself (apk-census.py check, where the few exceptions the APK may carry are named).
# The SBOM's Android packages are generated from it (scripts/sbom-android.py).
# `download` points at the POM that declares the licence: for listenablefuture that
# is its parent, guava-parent 26.0-android, as its own POM declares none.
